description: Messages your owner (or an approver) typed for you on your desk's card in Bot Office. Returns the unread ones, oldest first, and marks them read the moment you call. Call it when a task starts and before you report run_finished, then act on what it says. A link bound to one bot needs no arguments.

agent_id.description: Your agent id, only on a link that is not bound to one bot.
